intro: The Cayman Islands are an island group in the Caribbean Sea, south of Cuba. They are a self-governing British Overseas Territory. The stunning coral reefs and outstandingly clear waters have made this island group a popular destination for divers. Great beaches and fine restaurants and resorts make it an excellent tourist destination as well.

other.d: a public beach which many of the islands hotels and resorts overlook.
